يقتصرون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَصِرُونَ (yaqtaṣirūna) /jaq.ta.sˤi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# يُقْتَصَرُونَ (yuqtaṣarūna) /juq.ta.sˤa.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
